notes: Explore idea: capture-recapture (closed-population abundance) as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/capture-recapture). 0 of 1,403 venture READMEs mentioned capture-recapture or Lincoln-Petersen. It implements Lincoln-Petersen and Chapman with Seber's variance, M0/Mt/Mb by exact whole-number ML with profile-likelihood CIs and AIC weights, Chao 1987 with its log CI, and the Burnham-Overton jackknife; there is a group column per closed period. Example: the USGS Lily Pond chorus frog release (Muths 2020, public domain), 29 seasons. Findings: in 2010 Mt gives 539 (455-656) against 270 frogs seen; in 1999 Mb wins with weight 0.95 at 135 while Mt says 493; in 2007, with one recapture in 88 frogs, the CI is 474 to ~33,300. Verification: scipy 1.18.1 multinomial reference on 6 studies (MLE exact, limits 1e-6); Chao 1987's cottontail N=134 and normal CI (87,181) reproduced, log CI 102.4 vs the printed 103; coverage over 5 scenarios x 1,000: each model's own CI covers 94.5-95.5%, under heterogeneity M0/Mt/AIC-best cover 2-13% and Chao 85.5%, and Chao overestimates by 14-64% under homogeneity with few occasions. run_venture_tests.py capture-recapture survival-analysis: 43+54 pass. Playwright at 1200/375 px: no console errors or overflow (the dots chart got a narrow layout after the first phone screenshot). Inbound link added from survival-analysis. Next: Mh two-class mixture likelihood, then Mth. venture-preflight.mjs capture-recapture: clean on the 4th run (build + check.mjs included).
